status: Exploratory development; new source-separated confirmation performance has not been accessed.
features: Full and isolated contexts each provide logit rationale, logit document evidence, and document support/refutation direction confidence. Dual adds their predicted direction agreement and rationale/document-evidence differences. Dual_context additionally receives the frozen contextual metadata from the previous protocol.
selection: Same source-family-grouped four folds and 240 fitting / 60 threshold calibration development queries. Compare a separately tuned single-context control (all full/isolated raw and classifier candidates) against all candidates. Ties prefer raw scores and simpler declared candidates.
budget: Primary precision at exactly 100 admitted items per 100 queries, max within-query rank five.
smoke: Two inner folds first to verify finite scores, row-order/outcome invariance, exact budgets; full selection uses four folds only after passing smoke.
confirmation: Use the same 537 source-separated reserved claims only after models and thresholds are frozen. Primary controlled pools plus natural pools. Matched models use identical information availability and candidate filtering.
stopping: One full development run. Confirmation outcomes will not be used for candidate or threshold tuning.
